Follow-up total-body 18F-FDG PET-CT after treatment, about 4 months after the staging PET-CT (type and number of cycles not indicated), contrast-enhanced CT. Weight at follow-up 57 kg (72 kg at staging). The images and report of the staging PET-CT are available.
Confronta con la PET-TC di stadiazione e: Compare with the staging PET-CT and report the response (Deauville scale).
Nella PET-TC di controllo del linfoma si:
In follow-up PET-CT for lymphoma, every disease site from staging is examined (this is precisely what the prior report is for) and the residual uptake is compared with the mediastinal blood pool and with the liver of the same exam: this is the Deauville scale (Lugano 2014). 1 = no uptake above background; 2 = ≤ mediastinum; 3 = > mediastinum and ≤ liver; 4 = moderately > liver; 5 = markedly > liver or new lesions. At end of treatment 1-3 is a complete metabolic response even if a mass remains on CT.

Here at staging there were a bulky conglomerate along the right iliac chain down to the groin (with thigh edema) and a subcarinal lymph node: disease above and below the diaphragm. At follow-up none of these sites takes up more than background: Deauville 1, complete metabolic response. The remaining uptakes are physiologic: myocardium (variable, often intense), urinary tract, bowel.

Two technical pitfalls of the comparison: weight (here 15 kg less: the SUV must be recalculated with the weight of the day) and extravasation of the radiopharmaceutical at the injection site (present at staging: it reduces the dose reaching the circulation and lowers the SUVs of the entire exam).

Total-body 18F-FDG PET-CT (about 290 MBq, acquisition about 60 minutes after injection); contrast-enhanced CT. Weight 72 kg.

Bulky avid lymph node conglomerate along the right common and external iliac chains, extending to the inguinal region and the root of the right thigh (craniocaudal extent over 20 cm), with edema of the subcutaneous tissue of the right thigh. Avid subcarinal lymph node. No other definite disease sites.
Extravasation of the radiopharmaceutical at the injection site in the right arm: the SUV values of this exam are underestimated.
Physiologic uptake of the myocardium; urinary excretion.

Conclusions: lymphoma with lymph node involvement above and below the diaphragm (stage III according to Lugano), bulky right iliac-inguinal disease.
